VT: position cursor; takes row then column as ASCII digits
CR: carriage return to column 0
LF: line feed
DC1: cursor up one row
DC3: cursor left, wrapping to the previous row
DC4: cursor down one row
ETB: erase from the cursor to the end of the line
EM: erase from the cursor to the end of the display
TAB: reply with row and column as ASCII digits
SO: reply with the character at the cursor
SI: reply with the buffer contents from the cursor
SUB: reply with 45 bytes from 0x0064 - version string and config block
ESC: collect a parameter sequence. Disabled unless ROM 0x0077 is 1
STX: start of text; buffer to 0xE001, sets msg_active
ETX: end of text; replies ACK (0x06) or NAK (0x15) from msg_error
